I was on the hunt for an affordable yet reliable TV and stumbled upon Skylive's TV. It has far exceeded my expectations! The picture quality is excellent for the price, and it comes with all the essential features I need. It’s perfect for my small apartment and proves you don’t need to break the bank for a great viewing experience.

Mehak

The BoomBox has completely changed the game for our weekend gatherings. Its deep bass and crystal-clear highs ensure every genre of music comes to life. Couldn’t ask for a better party companion.

Harshita

As an avid gamer, I needed a TV that could keep up with fast-paced action without lag or blur. Gaming on Skylive’s TV is incredibly smooth, and the HDR makes the graphics pop. It’s also great for watching sports. A total game-changer for any entertainment setup.

Gagan

Their powerbank is the perfect size to slip into my pocket or purse, and it gives my phone a full charge at least once, sometimes twice. The build quality is solid, and it charges my devices quickly. For anyone who’s always on the move and needs a reliable power boost, this is a must-have.

Akansha

The adapter has made a significant difference in how quickly I can power up my iPhone. It supports fast charging, and I’ve cut down the time it takes to charge my phone by almost half. It’s compact, which is great for travel, and feels very durable. For anyone looking to speed up their iPhone charging time, this is the way to go.

Harsh

items.title: Set Location
items.snippet:
TheSkyLive is a comprehensive set of tools for everyone interested in the observation of astronomical objects and events. It's useful at any level: from simply checking the time of sunrise or the current phase of the Moon, to planning observations of newly discovered comets. While the main focus is the Solar System (TheSkyLive currently tracks 487 objects classified asMajor Objects,Comets,Asteroids & Dwarf Planets,Near Earth ObjectsSpace Probes), TheSkyLive also provides extensive reference information about constellations, stars, deep-sky objects, and the most interesting supernovae.
[...]
TheSkyLive is available 1) as a website accessible on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices athttps://theskylive.comor; 2) as a mobile app, currently on Android devices and found on the Google Play Store at athttps://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.theskylive.androidapp.
[...]
TheSkyLive was launched in 2013 and has been growing in functionality since. This project integrates an increasing set of astronomical datasets, libraries, and source code. The rest of this page details these dependencies and acknowledges their respective authors.
 # Datasets and Imagery
[...]
My name is Iacopo, and I am based in Northern Italy. TheSkyLive is a personal project of mine, that I have been running since its launch back in 2013.
[...]
For any enquiry please
